### Amaziah Reigns in Judah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/amaziah-reigns-judah
Passage: 2 Kings 14:3-4
Points:
- Amaziah began his reign doing what was right before God and obeying biblical commands.
- His obedience was qualified because he failed to remove the idolatrous high places.
- He imitated the flawed example of his father Joash rather than David's wholehearted devotion.
- Half-hearted obedience tolerates compromises that open the door to deeper spiritual decline.
- Believers are called to diligent faithfulness even in small matters to guard against future falls.
